scope: every verified scene mutation reveals its subject; a recolour reaches the drawn material

gates.runner: bun run test (tsx --test, node:test) — the project's configured command
gates.theOneRealFailure: tests/spatial-reveal.test.ts imported bun:test (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME); rewritten for node:test

earlierBunTestNumbers.note: measured with `bun test`, which is not this project's runner; the 38 were its node:test compatibility path (indexedDB undefined), not product failures

mutationReveal.rule: after verification, every mutation except object.delete requests a reveal; refused/rolled-back changes request nothing

renderingBug.symptom: material.set committed #22c55e, mesh probe and render model both green, published frame still lavender
renderingBug.cause: DEFAULT_SPATIAL_EMISSIVE #a78bfa at intensity 0.35 (+0.65 while attended) painted a violet glow that a colour change never touched
renderingBug.fix: a colour change mirrors the colour into emissive unless a specific glow was requested

resize.reply: Resized "Nova" to 1.5× its base size. Scene revision 2.
resize.reveal: Framed "Nova" — camera at (5.38, 0.65, 7.9) looking at (2.23, -1.35, 2.17). verification: camera pass, framing pass
resize.note: framing holds screen size constant; the resize is proven by the scale readout and the farther camera (4.3 → 5.38), not by a larger bounding box

recolour.reveal: Framed "Nova" — camera at (4.3, -0.01, 6.02) looking at (2.2, -1.35, 2.2). verification: camera pass, framing pass
recolour.measurement: green-channel-dominant pixels in the world band of the published PNG; captured only after real animation frames, with a before shot to prove the detector is not matching background

limits: viewport emulation, not a physical device; guest sign-in

voice and dashboard surfaces were not driven end-to-end in the browser (no microphone; no spatial creation control on the dashboard); the rule is enforced at the single bus every path calls and covered by bus-level tests
camera commands issued from chat on a phone report 'camera not measurable' because the world is unmounted there by design
proactive toasts can overlay the world in captures
the full browser sequence and the focused recolour run are separate because one command is capped at 290s
